issue_context.title: Turn off HVAC lead to error message `The heat and cool setpoints must be at least 2 degrees different.`
comments:
Hey there @bdraco, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`nexia`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L691) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>


It looks like we need to ignore the deadband check when turning off

Unfortunately it looks like this never worked, and its not an easy problem to solve since it will require an api change as there is currently no way to set a hold without setting the temp range since `call_permanent_hold` expects to have hold temps.

thanks @bdraco 

looks like you made some edits to the code. 

I was going to say perhaps I could include a "permanent hold" or "follow schedule" request before the "off" call, like this:

```
     - service: nexia.set_hvac_run_mode
        data:
            run_mode: permanent_hold
            hvac_mode: cool
         target:
         entity_id: climate.house_thermostat_nativezone
  - service: climate.set_hvac_mode
    data:
      hvac_mode: 'off'
    target:
      entity_id: climate.house_thermostat_nativezone
```

OR

```
     - service: nexia.set_hvac_run_mode
        data:
            run_mode: run_schedule
            hvac_mode: cool
         target:
         entity_id: climate.house_thermostat_nativezone
  - service: climate.set_hvac_mode
    data:
      hvac_mode: 'off'
    target:
      entity_id: climate.house_thermostat_nativezone
```

This could force and satisfy the 2 degree difference before shutdown.

BUT since you modifyed the code for this issue. i'll leave the entries out
